sketch:
Observe: SVG canvas with a component palette (pile, interrupteur,
lampe, fils) and an empty schematic grid. Student drags components
onto grid nodes, wires them, closes the switch, and the lamp
illuminates when the loop is complete (topology check). Experiment:
given a target ("allumer 2 lampes en série puis en parallèle"),
student builds each and toggles a switch to compare brightness.
Evaluate: component palette hidden; only a partial schematic given —
student adds the missing wire / switch to close it. Wrinkle:
short-circuit detection blows a fuse (small anim), teaching the
difference série/dérivation.
